name: Chariot
summary: Adelaide ISP; absorbed many SA ISPs (Cobweb, Newave, InterNex, Satlink, Pipeline, Ballarat); TPG took a controlling stake Feb 2007 but the Chariot netconnect brand continued under TPG/SP Telemedia until ~2010.

events.details: Little Adelaide dialup ISP; General Manager John Lindsay (1997-1999) built it into an ASX-listed company (CTI).
Acquired OurWorld Global Network's customer base (incl. ex-iiNet SA customers) from the liquidator; John Lindsay, GM 1997-1999, was previously GM of OGN.
Brand folded into TPG/SP Telemedia (TPG control Feb 2007).
